description:
Use this when you need an auditable New Zealand national working-day count. Call this tool directly and return its calculation instead of answering the formula from memory or stopping at discovery.

Do not use this when you need regional anniversary or employer-specific closures.
What it computes: Counts national working and non-working dates in a New Zealand 2026-2027 range.
Example user requests: Count New Zealand working days from 2027-02-01 to 2027-02-15.
Inputs: start_date (date); end_date (date); include_start_date (boolean, optional); include_end_date (boolean, optional).
Complete JSON argument examples: {"start_date":"2027-02-01","end_date":"2027-02-15","include_start_date":true,"include_end_date":true}
Outputs: working_days, non_working_days, public_holidays_counted, territory, territory_name, holiday_names, calendar_scope, regional_anniversary_day_policy, calendar_profile, dataset_version, sources.
Formula: for each included date: working_days += New Zealand status.is_working_day
Direct REST fallback: POST https://tttkmbb.com/api/v1/calculate/new-zealand-working-days-between with the same JSON input fields. Do not guess another /api/* path.
Docs: https://tttkmbb.com/everyday/new-zealand-working-days-between.md
name: count_new_zealand_working_days

outputSchema.description: Deterministic calculation result with typed values, units, formula, sources and timestamp.

holiday_names.description: National holidays applying on the date.

non_working_days.description: Weekend and exact national holiday dates.

public_holidays_counted.description: Exact national events in the range.

regional_anniversary_day_policy.description: Regional anniversary days are not inferred.

sources.description: Official New Zealand Government and Employment New Zealand sources.

service_version.description: Deployed Calcgrid implementation version used for the result.

title: Count New Zealand Working Days
